````text
# #2340: CI: a patches promotion or log is stuck
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

<!-- stuck #2331 -->
The technical log's pull request https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/2331 (`patches log`, R1369000) has been open over 2 hours and did not merge itself:

- [web (unit 1/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40814079383/job/123275421803)
- [web](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40814079383/job/123286371395)

Until its entries are on main, the 31 commit(s) it logs are missing from the technical log, and nothing logs them again: a later log holds only what went live after it.

Fix it on a branch from main: add the entries this pull request adds to `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` as they are, each after the entry it follows here, and keep main's, each commit once (`cargo jackioh patches check` holds the file's shape). Keep their `version`, the patch that was live when they went live (R1369000): `cargo jackioh patches log` run again would log them on today's. Fix too any check red here that is red on main. Close this issue with that pull request; the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` then closes this one.

If they are red for a reason outside the repository (CI or Render out of minutes, a spending limit, billing, an account, a runner that never started), no change here fixes it: open the plan with a `**Human required:**` line saying what a person must do, and build nothing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-6` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40828892013)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** Get the 31 technical-log entries of the stuck log PR #2331 onto main. #2331 is `patches log: eba6392..da5a454`, branch `origin/patches/log-da5a454`, head commit `4cf42d8d0562fc3548ede1bda2804d2f02551905`. The entries go into `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` exactly as #2331 has them, with every `version` left at `v0.5.2` (R1369000). They go right after the entry they follow on #2331: main's last entry today, commit `eba63924d1a62b58560b8f0ab8e7c93f59c0357e` (`"pr": 2232`). All of main's entries stay, and each commit appears once. The check that was red on #2331, `web (unit 1/4)` and its summary `web`, is already green on main, so no code changes. The pull request's description says `Closes #2340`; the watch in `patches-ship.yml` then closes #2331 by itself.

What the planner ran and saw (base `2c9680cb1`):
- **Main's file is #2331's starting point.** Main's `technical.json` (blob `a7c934c41`, 359 entries) is byte for byte the file #2331 started from (`4cf42d8d0~1`). #2331 changes only this file: 217 lines added, 0 removed, 31 entries, all `v0.5.2`.
- **The entries are valid.** A Python check found none of the 31 commits on main's log already and no duplicates. All 31 are first-parent commits of main, and `v0.5.2` is in `patches.json`.
- **Why #2331 was red.** `apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts`, test "#2109 the board's stylesheets state no radius, shadow, layer or background gradient of their own", fails at #2331's base (`f9249bab9`). It flags `game/handHints.css: border-radius: 999px` and `game/handHints.css: z-index: 4`. The planner reproduced this by putting `f9249bab9`'s `handHints.css` into a scratch copy of main. Main's `2c9680cb1` (#2313) changed both lines to `var(--radius-pill)` and `var(--z-hover)`.
- **Main plus #2331's file passes the web tests.** Four files (`surfaces.test.ts`, `wording.test.ts`, `patches/PatchNotes.test.tsx`, `static-pages.test.ts`, 53 tests) pass on main, and again in a scratch copy of main with #2331's file. The whole web suite in that scratch copy (with the harness's excludes): 364 files pass. 9 tests in 3 files failed only with `ENOENT … wasm/pkg/luau/jackioh_wasm_luau.wasm`, because the planner built the wasm module with `JACKIOH_WASM_LUAU=0`; that is the planner's setup, not main.
- **Precedent.** #2296 (`b74d2888f`, for the stuck log #2242, issue #2276) did the same thing and changed only this file.

**Files to touch.**

| Path | new/change | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` | change | Add #2331's 31 entries right after the `eba63924d…` (`"pr": 2232`) entry; change nothing else. |

Do not touch any other file. In particular:
- not `crates/cards/patches/patches.json`;
- no pending fragment, ruling or `spec/` note;
- not `apps/web/src/game/handHints.css` or `apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts`, which are fixed on main already;
- nothing under `.github/`.

Do not run `cargo jackioh patches log`: it would log the commits again on today's patch, not the one that was live when they went live. Rules that govern this: R1369000 (`spec/rulings/R1369000.md`, the log's shape and versions), R105 (versions are opaque) and R724001 (player lines follow the note rules). No new ruling is needed, because no rules decision is made.

**Steps.**

1. Check that #2331's commit is present: `git cat-file -e 4cf42d8d0562fc3548ede1bda2804d2f02551905 && echo ok`. If it prints no `ok`, stop and report that #2331's head commit is missing from the clone. Do not type the entries by hand.
2. From the worktree root, run this exactly. It reads #2331's file from git and adds its 31 entries after `eba63924d…` in main's file. Entries main already holds are skipped, and any entries main has gained after that one are kept after the inserted block.
   ```sh
   python3 -I - <<'EOF'
   import json, subprocess
   PATH = "crates/cards/patches/technical.json"
   LOG = "4cf42d8d0562fc3548ede1bda2804d2f02551905"   # #2331, patches log: eba6392..da5a454
   AFTER = "eba63924d1a62b58560b8f0ab8e7c93f59c0357e"  # the entry #2331's first new entry follows
   pr = json.loads(subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{LOG}:{PATH}"], capture_output=True, encoding="utf-8", check=True).stdout)
   main = json.load(open(PATH, encoding="utf-8"))
   new = pr[[e["commit"] for e in pr].index(AFTER) + 1:]
   assert len(new) == 31, len(new)
   have = {e["commit"] for e in main}
   at = [e["commit"] for e in main].index(AFTER) + 1
   out = main[:at] + [e for e in new if e["commit"] not in have] + main[at:]
   open(PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
   print(len(main), "->", len(out))
   EOF
   ```
   On today's main it prints `359 -> 390`. The planner ran this script with its output sent to a file in `/tmp`; the result was byte for byte #2331's file. `json.dumps(indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)` reproduces main's file unchanged.
3. Check the diff with `git diff --numstat -- crates/cards/patches/technical.json`.
   - On today's main it must print `217	0	crates/cards/patches/technical.json`. If main has moved, it should be fewer additions, and always `0` deletions.
   - Any deletion means the file was reformatted. Put the file back with `git show HEAD:crates/cards/patches/technical.json > crates/cards/patches/technical.json` and report.
   - If main already held all 31 commits (`390` was never reached and the script added nothing), there is nothing to land: make no change and report that the watch will close #2331.
4. Check that `git status --porcelain` lists only `crates/cards/patches/technical.json`.

**Tests.**

No test is added. The change is data, and existing checks already hold it to its shape and show it on the page:
- `cargo jackioh patches check` passes. Through `check_technical` in `crates/tools/src/technical.rs`, it requires each commit once, every version in `patches.json`, no `cards` kind and no pull request 0, and player lines that follow R724001.
- `jq -r '.[].commit' crates/cards/patches/technical.json | sort | uniq -d` prints nothing.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/wording.test.ts src/patches/PatchNotes.test.tsx src/static-pages.test.ts src/surfaces.test.ts`: 4 files, 53 tests pass. These include:
  - `wording.test.ts`, "R724001 R1369000 no player note in patches.json or line of technical.json says library, sacrifice, an old cost form, Degrade or Upgrade". It reads the three new player lines (#2228, #2245, #2189).
  - `PatchNotes.test.tsx`, "R1369000 the real log's player lines are on the page under their X". It checks those lines appear under `v0.5.2`.
  - `surfaces.test.ts`, the check that was red on #2331.

  Run `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` first, with the default Luau build, or the Luau tests fail with ENOENT.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes with no fragment. `crates/cards/patches/` counts as App, and no card plays differently.

**Done when.**
- [ ] `technical.json` holds #2331's 31 entries unchanged (`version` `v0.5.2`), in #2331's order, right after the `eba63924d…` entry, with every entry main had. Each commit appears once.
- [ ] `git diff --numstat` shows 0 deletions, and only that file has changed.
- [ ] `patches check`, `classify --claims`, the duplicate check and the four web test files above are green.
- [ ] The harness's checks are green: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests.
- [ ] The pull request's description says `Closes #2340`.
- [ ] The report names every red check, if any, and says whether the same check is red on main (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

**Risks.**
- **Main moves before the build.** If a newer `patches/log-*` lands first, main gains entries after `eba63924d…`. Step 2 inserts #2331's entries before those and keeps them, which is "each after the entry it follows". Step 3's zero-deletion check catches anything else.
- **Reformatting.** The whole file is rewritten. The planner confirmed the round trip leaves main's file byte for byte unchanged; step 3 proves it again.
- **Wrong version.** Re-logging with `patches log` could stamp a different version or player line. Copying #2331's entries keeps theirs.
- **Another red check on the new PR.** If a CI job other than the ones above goes red, do not weaken any check. Name it in the report and say whether it is red on main.
- **No effect on game behaviour.** Determinism, replay and hidden information are untouched: only the tools and the public Patch notes page read this file.

**Open questions.**
- None for a person.
- By the difficulty rule this reads as **medium** (one data file under `crates/cards/patches/`, rule line 5), not hard. The label set by a person stands.
````
